To scratch an itch more than anything. But even then, I like to know how much time is left. If I don't hear the alarm sound, I wanted it to keep repeating. And then if I didn't realize it was going off, I wanted it to show how long the alarm was going off. Then one time my sound was really low and I really didn't hear it (living in an apartment complex with a shared laundry room, people sometimes get pissed if you aren't on top of the laundry), so I added a little to push the sound up during the alarm, then move it back to what it was after you hit a key. I called it countdown, but my kid kept trying to type in timer so I added the alias at the top. I actually use it quite a lot, so thought I'd share. I just >timer 30and I have a 30 minute timer counting down.

Thanks for this. I took it and added a bit to it. This is what my version looks like.

#! /bin/bash


#
# Countdown - countdown specified number of minutes showing live time
# remaining.
#
# Parameters:
#
# $1 - mandatory - number of minutes to countdown
# $2 - optional - command to run when time runs out
#
countdown () {
 if [ -z "${1}" ]; then
 echo "No time specified for countdown()."
 return 1
 fi

 if [ ! -z "${2}" ]; then
 finish_command="${2}"
 else
 finish_command="cdfinish"
 fi

 if [ "${CDCLEAR}" = "true" ]; then
 reset
 fi

 temp=`echo "$1*60" | bc`
 min=`printf %.0f $temp`
 date1=$((`date +%s` + min));

 while [ "$date1" -gt `date +%s` ]; do
 echo -ne "$(date -u --date @$(($date1 - `date +%s`)) +%H:%M:%S)\r";
 sleep 0.1
 done
 echo '00:00:00'

 $finish_command

 if [ "${CDCLEAR}" = "true" ]; then
 clear
 fi
 echo -e "Alarm duration: $(date -u --date @$((`date +%s` - $date1)) +%H:%M:%S)\r";
}


#
# clear_countdown - Runs countdown, but also clears the terminal before and
# after.
#
clear_countdown () {
 CDCLEAR=true
 countdown "${1}" "${2}"
 unset CDCLEAR
}


#
# cdfinish - Countdown’s standard finish command.
#
# This sets the volume (if it’s not turned off or near 0) and plays a sound
# file.
#
cdfinish () {
 if [ ! -z "${1}" ]; then
 sound_file="${1}"
 else
 sound_file="${HOME}/.local/lib/countdown/pink-floyd-time-trimmed.flac"
 fi

 #vol=`amixer get Master | grep 'Left:' | awk '{print $5}' | sed "s/[^0-9]//g"`
 vol=`amixer get Master | grep 'Mono: ' | awk '{print $4}' | sed "s/[^0-9]//g"`
 #amixer set Master 35%
 amixer set Master 80% > /dev/null

 echo -e "\nPress space bar to end alarm.";
 cvlc "${sound_file}" --global-key-quit ' ' --play-and-exit 2>/dev/null

 amixer set Master $vol% > /dev/null
}
